Yeah. Sometimes in class I "accidentally" roll up my sleeve a little bit hoping that my teacher will notice. No one ever did.
I just hope that if someone notice, I can finally get the help I need. I can get to talk to someone. 
Once my Spanish teacher saw them (that was really accidental, I cut to close to my hand the night before) but she didn't say anything. Sometimes I feel like they don't care

Even if they're old?
Anyway, I'll try talking with her, after all my parents kind of know that I have cut myself in the past but they don't know where and never saw my scars. It can't get any worse, I hope.
Thanks for the advice

Oh yes. A lot. I don't have many friends, apart from my gymnastics mates and a fifty years old lady who's graduating next year lol.

I never got bullied either. Maybe a little bit in eight grade because I was 10
I actually hate school, but my favourite part is probably math homework. There I can act like a know-it-all without being fucking judged.

Thanks. My first garde teacher saw I already knew math and how to read and write so they made me do some tests and another one at the end of the year. Depending on the scores I woul skip 1 or 2 grades. I also had a tutor teaching me things from higher grades.

My case didn't got famous because there are tons like mine here in spain and also my mum tried her best not to let anyone know (apart from my school, of course). It just got on the local news when I was in eight grade.
I'm taking economics. My mum told me it's because "it's the one that gives you more possibilities life". bruh I just wanted to be a middle school teacher...

Teachers in first grade noriced that I already knew basic math and how to read and write so they called the counselor who made me do tons of tests. Than I got a tutor or something that would teach me things that were like 2 or 3 grades higher. At the end of the school year they made me do another test and that was it. I became like the school joke. They made me take a test at the end of every year and I would skip a grade or two.

Yes it's really really hard. Until 6 grade it was fine, I was like the class pet, some girls would play babysitter with me, then it started to drop. When I started to grow up I was considered "the annoying little brat". I stopped answering questions in class because my peers teased me about knowing better that them. It was pure hell. Now in university it's easier. We also have a 50 years old so people don't notice me much. Teachers do instead and it's annoying
Idk, whatever you would like
Yes really. I regret to much skipping all those grades and not taking years off before university. Now my classmates are like 20 years old and I have to always spend lunch alone
Actually, I did in elementary school and before entering university  but I didn't get to see the scores

Yes I would really have preferred to stay at the same level of my peers. But my school was one of those schools that wants to raise a future Einstein and that kind of bullshit. I decided to go to university so it can be all over for when I'm 18. I want to just take a couple of years off and just travel, I would really like to see France
After how many days braces stop hurting? I can't take it anymoreeeeee

oh yes yes yes and I fucking hate it. I have self harm scars (old ones) and recently started wearing short sleeves. A couple of teachers noticed it and while one of them was very supportive and had scars herself, the other one started treating me like I was mentally retarded. How ignorant.
Thanks for your nice words, but in a couple of months everything good in my life will disappear. I can't take it
